traces for emailservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 0.19->0.19ms (1.04x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 3.53->203.82ms (57.79x), errors 0.0->0.0

alternatives_rejected.why: Its latency rise is far smaller (latency-90 up 105.7%) than emailservice's (up 4498.7%) (E1). It is consistent with checkoutservice waiting on its slow emailservice calls, since inbound calls to emailservice rose from 3.53 to 203.82ms (E2).

emailservice's own processing time did not change (0.19 to 0.19ms, 1.04x) (E2), which rules out CPU-bound slowness. Also, E1's all-services scan surfaced no CPU deviation; the only significant deviations were latency metrics.

proposed_fix.description: Remove the network delay on the emailservice pod or its network path, for example by clearing the tc/netem qdisc or removing the chaos experiment. Then confirm that the latency callers see from emailservice and checkoutservice latency return to baseline.
